title: c0sv (tombstone): three_rpl_stacks fixture reconciled — 294/294 green (commit e75754a0cf)
description: TRACKER REPAIR: the bead project-LICHEN-worker6-c0sv (three_rpl_stacks fixture reconciliation) was LOST from the shared store by the bd8h write-loss pattern after the fix was committed. Resolution recorded here: root cause was NOT admission or TOFU — the shared broadcast medium queues frames per-receiver in transmission order, and after the ehcn option-A re-target the RELAY's solicited-DIS multicast DIO response is queued at ROOT ahead of the relay's DAO; root (provision_root) rejects DIOs, so the fixture popped RplRejected where it expected Dao(Applied). Fix (fixture only): drain root's queued RplRejected after the DIS exchange; drain stale frames before the DIS/DAO exchange. Committed as e75754a0cf on beads-worker-7. Verification: cargo test -p lichen-node --features std --lib 294/294 green, fmt clean. No production change, no assertion weakening.
